title: Snap
description: Snap for two to four people around one phone. Lay it flat and take the pad on your own edge — every pad is turned the right way up for where you are sitting. Cards flip onto a green baize table by themselves, landing with a shadow and a crooked little bounce. The instant one lands on its own rank the ring turns gold, and the first hand down takes the whole pile. Slam at nothing and it costs you a card. The race is settled by which finger the phone felt first, so a dead heat has exactly one winner — and the fastest hand of the night goes to the global board.
